summary: Portions of land will be provided for the sanctuary and the dwellings of the priests—The people are to offer their sacrifices and oblations and keep their feasts.
meta_description: Portions of land will be provided for the sanctuary and the dwellings of the priests—The people are to offer their sacrifices and oblations and keep their feasts.

footnotes.note9_b: OR expropriations; i.e., illegal taking away of property or possessions.
